## ZGTA V

**2.0 beta · by zema**

Solo Story, Free Roam and Private Multiplayer.

**Build 97 candidate · Installer 0.97-1**

Improved nearby LAN lobby discovery and refresh. Local build and package checks pass; iPhone discovery and gameplay testing are still pending.

**Requires iOS / iPadOS 15.0 or later**, compatible TrollStore / TrollStore Lite and your own prepared game files.

Install this package to install ZGTA V through your existing TrollStore setup. Update over the existing app. Removing this installer package leaves the app and its data installed.
[Remote play with Tailscale](https://github.com/zemabinks/ZGTA-V/blob/main/docs/REMOTE-PLAY.md) — downloads, setup, host and join steps.

### Installer 0.97-1 / App Build 97
- Improve nearby LAN lobby discovery, retries and refresh.
- Install the verified Build97 IPA.
- Phone installation, discovery and gameplay testing pending.

### Installer 0.96-1 / App Build 96
- Apply the revised bounded host-broadcast capacity fix.
- Pin the exact Build96 IPA by size and SHA-256.
- Keep existing installer/helper behavior and previous package versions.
- Physical phone and paired gameplay retest pending.

- Fix opening archives found by a folder scan.

- Improve game-folder scanning and use English throughout the menus.
